subject.title: fix(infra): make exec-approvals lock ownership filesystem-safe

question: Which active PR should be the single canonical fix for the exec-approvals VirtioFS lock leak: this current-main rebase or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028?
rationale: Both branches carry the same central implementation, while the earlier branch contains the original runtime investigation and this rebase needs head-specific behavior proof; selecting one branch is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical review outcome.

options.title: Adopt this rebased branch after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch, require a redacted current-head VirtioFS run, and close or supersede the earlier duplicate once that proof is attached.

options.title: Adopt the earlier branch
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028, rebase it to current main, and preserve its existing investigation and proof trail there.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebased branch after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch, require a redacted current-head VirtioFS run, and close or supersede the earlier duplicate once that proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the detailed reproduction and the active earlier implementation thread that this branch replays.
